articles.summary: CONEXPO‑CON/AGG 2026 will mark the first appearance of TerraSource equipment in the Astec booth following the company’s acquisition in 2025.

articles.title: Built from Legacy. Redesigned for the Future. Astec Launches the A50 Jaw Crusher.
